mainEntity.name: How can I finance an ADU project, and what are my options?

acceptedAnswer.text: Financing options for an ADU project include cash-out refinancing, home equity lines of credit (HELOCs), construction loans, and personal loans. Each option has different interest rates, repayment terms, and eligibility requirements. For instance, a construction loan might be suitable for a new build, while a HELOC could work for smaller conversions if you have sufficient home equity. We recommend consulting with a financial advisor to determine the best financing strategy for your specific situation and property.
